FAQ Accordion Generator

Build an accessible FAQ accordion (ARIA, keyboard-friendly) — live preview plus HTML, CSS and JS.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter each FAQ as a block: question line, then answer lines, blank line between FAQs.
  2. Pick the accent color and icon style.
  3. Test the live preview — it is fully clickable.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained faq.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the accordion accessible?

Yes. It uses <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls, regions with role="region", and works with keyboard Enter/Space.

How are FAQs parsed?

Blank lines split blocks; the first line of each block is the question, the rest is the answer.

Can multiple items be open?

By default opening one closes the others. Edit the JS if you want independent toggling.

Does it need any library?

No — vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript only.
